# Tomesi

> Tomesi is an AI assistant app for iPhone that runs entirely on the device. After a one-time model download, it works with no internet connection, even in airplane mode. Conversations and documents never leave the phone. No account, no subscription, no ads: a one-time purchase on the App Store. Tomesi was previously named MonIA.

## Key facts

- Platform: iPhone 15 Pro or newer (8 GB of RAM) with iOS 26 or later. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6783248212?pt=129072363&ct=site&mt=8
- Privacy: everything is processed on the device. App Store privacy label: "Data Not Collected". No account, no analytics, no tracking.
- Offline use: the AI model is downloaded once through Apple's delivery system (about 1.7 GB). After that, no connection is needed.
- Models: open-weight models run on the iPhone with Apple MLX. Standard mode uses Qwen 3.5 2B. The optional Precision mode (about 3 GB more) uses Gemma 4 E2B for more accurate answers.
- Features: chat, voice conversation with on-device dictation and read-aloud, document scanning, questions about PDFs, conversation search, custom assistants with their own documents, photo analysis.
- Languages: interface in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Russian. The assistant can answer in more languages.
- Pricing: one-time purchase. No subscription, no in-app purchase.
- Limits: smaller than cloud assistants such as ChatGPT, so answers are less encyclopedic and can contain mistakes. No web browsing: answers come from the model's built-in knowledge and the user's own documents.
- Developer: independent developer based in France. Support: support@tomesi.com
